about:
Agri-Industrial Plastics Co. was founded in 1978 by Dick Smith in Fairfield, Iowa. The company began by collaborating with industry leaders to advance plastic blow molding technology. After 37 years at the helm, Smith stepped down as president in 2015 and his daughter, Lori, assumed leadership, keeping the business family-owned.

The company operates a 340,000-square-foot manufacturing facility housing 20 monolayer accumulator-head blow molding machines and eight multilayer continuous coextrusion machines dedicated to producing EPA-compliant, non-automotive fuel tanks. In addition to blow molding, Agri-Industrial provides engineering and design support, assembly, packaging, and quality inspection using a Shape Grabber laser scanner for dimensional verification.

Its customer base spans the turf equipment, power sports, agricultural, and marine sectors, with additional work in lawn and garden and recreational watercraft. Long-standing clients include EXCEL Industries (Hustler Turf Equipment), Kubota Manufacturing of America, and John Deere, all of whom cite the company’s on-time delivery and design collaboration.

Agri-Industrial’s stated vision is to be the leading provider of innovative, high-quality blow molded solutions. The company emphasizes a systematic quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015, advanced product quality planning, and Level III PPAP capability as core differentiators.
